bio:
VLSI trainer is a technical expert who teaches the design and manufacturing of integrated circuits (microchips). They bridge the gap between academic theory and semiconductor industry demands.
Key Focus Areas
• Front-End Design: Teaching hardware languages like Verilog/SystemVerilog, architecture, and verification (UVM).
• Back-End Design: Teaching physical placement, routing, and timing analysis on actual silicon chips.
• Target Audience: Upskilling engineering students, recent graduates, and corporate professionals for semiconductor roles.
